candidate_layout_unknown.description: No candidate projection: the recognition pack declares no fixed_slots candidate layout with the requested ID.

candidate_feature_failed.description: No candidate projection: a feature's target could not be evaluated or measured; the recognition error travels as the cause.

candidate_feature_provider_missing.description: No candidate projection: a feature's target needs an OCR or NN provider the evaluator was built without.

candidate_samples_unavailable.description: No candidate projection: the frames given do not match the layout's required sample frames.

candidate_sample_geometry_changed.description: No candidate projection: a sample frame's geometry differs within the transaction.

candidate_sample_record_failed.description: No candidate projection: recording a candidate sample evaluation failed.

text_locate_not_found.description: A locate OCR target did not pass: no block read in its region matches an expected value with at least the target's minimum confidence (Workflow #396 REC-1). count is the number of blocks read. Carried as the target evaluation's failure; a guard refuses its input with it as the cause.

text_locate_outside_cells.description: A locate OCR target did not pass: the matching block's center lies in none of the target's declared cells (Workflow #396 REC-1). Carried as the target evaluation's failure.

text_read_budget_exceeded.description: A text read was refused before calling the OCR provider: one consumer (one page recognition or one guard evaluation) would exceed its budget of provider calls or of summed region area in pixels (Workflow #396 REC-1). count is the amount already used, limit_count the budget. An evaluation error.

text_read_blocks_truncated.description: A locate OCR target's detection found more boxes than the model folder's max_boxes, and the dropped boxes could change the conclusion: no block matched (Workflow #396 REC-1), or a block matched and the target declares unique (Workflow #396 REC-2). count is the number of boxes detected, limit_count the folder's max_boxes. An evaluation error.

target_match_not_unique.description: A target that declares unique did not pass: a second place scores at least the best match's score minus margin_milli (Workflow #396 REC-2). For a template, a position whose box does not intersect the best match's and that meets the target's own acceptance condition; for a locate OCR target, another block whose text matches, its confidence counted as 0 when absent. Scores are in milli, rounded down. Carried as the target evaluation's failure; a guard refuses its input with it as the cause.

target_match_search_incomplete.description: The exact score map of a template target that declares unique was not complete within the search limit timeout_ms (Workflow #396 REC-2). An evaluation error: the target never passes on a partial search.

text_locate_evaluate.description: Comparing a locate OCR target's blocks with its expected values and declared cells (Workflow #396 REC-1).

text_read_request.description: Checking one consumer's text read budget before calling the OCR provider (Workflow #396 REC-1).

target_match_unique.description: Searching a second place within the declared margin of a unique target's best match, or the exact score map that search reads (Workflow #396 REC-2).
